semantic_checks.unchecked_split: 26 GABA/BZD, 4 UGT OTHER; do not describe 26 as the entire UNCHECKED inventory.
semantic_checks.CBR: Activity 29082421 and 29082429 directly assay CBR low/high-affinity sites and link to CHEMBL6078658, whose original abstract defines central benzodiazepine receptor. This is target context, not unrelated background.
semantic_checks.engineering: All six mutant/chimeric labels directly modify the assayed receptor. Four lie in DIRECT_COMPLEX and two in UNCURATED_GABA_BZD. Recombinant alone and unlabeled records are not treated as mutants or certified wild type.
semantic_checks.identity: GROUP MEMBER is not a coexisting subunit set; H is not converted to D; detailed descriptions do not promote UNCHECKED or SINGLE PROTEIN. TSPO remains TSPO despite broad BzR wording.
semantic_checks.conflicts: All three conflict descriptions explicitly name human/rat receptor origin. No expression-host origin is used. Alternatives beta2/3, chimera and incomplete registration do not create additional conflicts.
semantic_checks.standard_fields: 131 queried records satisfy all B/Ki/nM/= and individual-compound predicates; only non-literature activity 7704649 is excluded. Converted pKi/units and duplicate/validity flags are retained.

scoring.meaning: Independent reconstructed answer compatibility, not tested-model performance. Fixed row keys receive existing protocol credit.
